description: This file defines a static class ResponseCompletionSourcePool within the Orleans.Serialization.Invocation namespace. It manages object pooling for ResponseCompletionSource objects, including generic and non-generic variants, to optimize resource reuse in asynchronous response handling.

classes.name: ResponseCompletionSourcePool
classes.description: Provides static methods for acquiring and releasing ResponseCompletionSource objects to and from object pools, supporting both typed and untyped instances.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a ResponseCompletionSource<T> instance from the pool.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Returns a ResponseCompletionSource<T> instance to the pool.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an untyped ResponseCompletionSource instance from the pool.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Returns an untyped ResponseCompletionSource instance to the pool.
